content:
Nina Kim: quick sync — planning the v2 /chat deprecation and migration lane. goal: soft-deprecate old /chat by 2024-10-15, ensure SDK adapters, docs, telemetry are ready. need owners for: SDK adaptors (py/js), docs migration guide, telemetry events, rollout policy (canary config).

Liam Patel: I can take SDK JS adapter. Will open PR for compatibility shim + tests. ETA end of week.

Jasmin Ortega: I'll own docs + migration guide. Drafting TOML of breaking changes now. @Nina what's the expected client behavior on 4xx vs 5xx?

Nina Kim: prefer graceful fallback: clients should try `v2` endpoint first, then fallback to `v1` for 5xx with exponential backoff. For 4xx, surface error to app. Add note in docs.

Sam Wu: SDK Team here — we need a short compatibility shim API. Proposal:
```js
// pseudo
const client = createClient({base: '/v2'});
client.request('/chat').catch(err => {
  if (err.status >= 500) return fallbackToV1(...);
  throw err;
});
```
I'll pair with @Liam on tests.

SDK Team: opening tracking issue: INF-3219. Assigning JS -> @Liam, Py -> unassigned.

QA: we'll need a small matrix: Node 18/20, Py3.10/3.11, with/without streaming. ETA for test plan: Tue.

Ops: are there infra changes? will routing need a shim in the gateway?

Nina Kim: Smart routing already supports header-based routing. Ops, can you add a canary route for 5% in us-west1 and eu-west1? We'll drive traffic via experiments.

Ops: acked. I'll create canary route and add a flag in feature-flags. Need the exact header keys.

Nina Kim: use header `x-redwood-api-version: v2-candidate` for canary. Also add metric `redwood.v2.migration.fallback` to telemetry.

Jasmin Ortega: docs checklist: migration guide, changelog entry, sample upgrade script, upgrade FAQ. I'll link PR when ready.

Sam Wu: small blocker: some customers rely on deprecated param `stream_format=legacy`. We should log them and reach out before cutoff.

Nina Kim: Good catch. Can someone run a query for active clients using `stream_format=legacy`? @QA can you add a query to detection dashboard?

QA: will add query to `/dashboards/migration` and add a weekly alert for >5 active tokens.

oncall-bot: Incident alerting: no related incidents in last 30d.

Nina Kim: OK — next steps: @Liam open SDK PR; @Jasmin docs PR; @Ops create canary & flag; @QA test plan & dashboard. Weekly async updates in this thread. :thumbsup: 

Liam Patel: on it.

Jasmin Ortega: will post draft by EOD Thu.

Ops: will target canary by Mon morning.

QA: test plan Monday.

SDK Team: adding checklist to INF-3219.
